summary: Stevanato Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing a presentation for its Q1 2026 investor conference call held on May 7, 2026. The presentation discusses financial results, forward-looking statements, and business updates. No special situation transaction — acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC-related event, or management change — is described. The filing is a routine earnings-related current report. As a foreign private issuer, the Form 6-K serves as the equivalent of a U.S. domestic 8-K for earnings materials. There are no deal terms or structural notes to report.
